# Spec: <topic>

<!-- Copy to docs/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-spec.md. The spec says WHAT and WHY, never HOW.
     Scale to the task: a few lines per section is fine for a small change. -->

- Status: Draft | Approved
- Date: YYYY-MM-DD
- Design: ../designs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md
- ADRs: ../adr/NNNN-<title>.md (only if the design makes an architecture decision)
- Plan: ../plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md

## Problem

What is wrong or missing today, and who it affects. Include evidence.

## Goals and success criteria

Numbered, measurable outcomes.

## Scope

What this change covers.

## Non-goals

What this change deliberately does not cover.

## Requirements

| ID | Requirement |
|---|---|
| R1 | ... |

## Acceptance criteria

Observable checks that prove the requirements are met.

## Open questions

Questions only the user can answer. Write "None" when there are none.
